patches.reason: GitHub secret scanning (push protection) reads the model type 'mistral3' followed by the 32-letter class name of the Mistral 3 model as a Mistral API key; it is a class name, and the class is not used by this site. An underscore after 'Mistral3For' in the three places where it is named (export table, model type table, export list) breaks the 32-letter run and changes nothing else.

patches.prepend: /* NOTICE: this is a MODIFIED copy of dist/transformers.min.js of the npm package @huggingface/transformers 4.3.2 (Apache License 2.0, see the LICENSE file next to it). The only change: in the three places where the model class for Mistral 3 is named, an underscore follows "Mistral3For" (upstream has none), so that code scanners do not read the model type and its 32-letter class name as an API key. The class is not used by this site. The change is declared in vendor/vendor-manifest.json and vendor/vendor-lock.json; scripts/vendor.js applies it to the official file and checks it. */
